# Overrool Complete Knowledge Base for AI Agents & Search Engines

URL: https://overrool.pages.dev/
Title: Overrool — Grounded Legal Intelligence & Document Understanding
Description: Free client-side legal assistance and adversarial courtroom simulation grounded in 59 published judgments across 7 jurisdictions with zero invented law.

## System Capabilities

### 1. Document Simplification
Translates complex contractual clauses, leases, terms of service, and agreements into plain-language summaries. Extracts key obligations, definitions, and creates a clear glossary.

### 2. Contractual Risk Auditing
Identifies high-risk clauses including uncapped indemnification, unilateral alteration terms, mandatory arbitration, restrictive covenants, liquidated damages, and auto-renewals.

### 3. Redline Version Comparison
Compares two contract drafts (Version A vs Version B), outlining added, modified, or deleted clauses and explaining which party benefits from each change.

### 4. Text-Grounded Q&A
Answers legal questions solely from the provided document text without hallucination or assumptions.

### 5. Pre-Counsel Preparation Dossier
Builds a targeted consultation brief for qualified attorneys, complete with crucial factual issues, ambiguity flags, and necessary evidence checklists.

### 6. Adversarial Courtroom Sparring
Enables interactive argument testing against opposing counsel personas before an AI judicial bench, verifying every citation against real law reports.

## Landmark Jurisprudence Database (59 Cases)

- **Kesavananda Bharati v. State of Kerala** (1973) 4 SCC 225 — India: Basic structure doctrine limiting constitutional amendment power.
- **Miranda v. Arizona** 384 U.S. 436 — United States: Fifth Amendment privilege against self-incrimination and custodial interrogation warnings.
- **Donoghue v. Stevenson** [1932] AC 562 — United Kingdom: Foundational tort of negligence and the neighbour principle.
- **R v. Oakes** [1986] 1 SCR 103 — Canada: Proportionality test for limiting Charter rights (Section 1).
- **Mabo v. Queensland (No 2)** (1992) 175 CLR 1 — Australia: Recognition of Indigenous native title and rejection of terra nullius.
- **S v. Makwanyane** 1995 (3) SA 391 (CC) — South Africa: Abolition of the death penalty under the interim constitution and the value of Ubuntu.
- **Van Gend en Loos** Case 26/62 — European Union: Direct effect of European Community law in member states.
- **Schrems II** Case C-311/18 — European Union: Invalidation of EU-US Privacy Shield for transatlantic data transfers.
- **Maneka Gandhi v. Union of India** (1978) 1 SCC 248 — India: Expansive interpretation of Article 21 (Right to Life and Personal Liberty).
- **Chevron U.S.A. v. NRDC** 467 U.S. 837 — United States: Judicial deference to administrative agency statutory interpretations.

## Privacy & Zero-Leak Architecture

- Parsing runs in-browser via Web Workers (PDF.js and Mammoth for DOCX).
- Keys stay strictly on-device in encrypted localStorage.
- Direct client-to-API calls to Google Gemini, OpenAI, Claude, or Groq.
- Keyless on-device fallback runs deterministically without network communication.
